protocol.input: 336x336 crop, no resizing; ImageNet mean/std; random horizontal flip (p=0.5)
protocol.head: new nn.Linear on the final-layer class token (post-LayerNorm); sigmoid; BCE

lora.targets: query, key, value and output projections of every block

protocol.selection: per strategy, the LR with the highest mean validation AUROC over D-bias and D-align (LP: also averaged over all seeds; LoRA: first seed only), AUROC rounded to 4 decimals; ties broken by the lower mean validation BCE
protocol.precision: fp16 autocast with gradient scaling (LoRA); frozen-feature extraction in fp16
